topic: New London School explosion (1937): leaked gas built up beneath the school until a shop-class sander ignited it near the end of the day

research_sources.institution: Texas State Library and Archives Commission
focus: ignited from a spark from a sander in a shop class

research_sources.institution: Texas State Historical Association, Handbook of Texas

research_cautions: Death toll is usually given as about 298 (TSHA); the State Library says about 300 victims. Times differ by source (3:05 vs 3:17 p.m.).
The shop instructor did not know gas was present; do not imply he was at fault.
